H1b.rule: lower bound of the 95% task-bootstrap CI > 0

section11.rule: p_bar < 0.1 or > 0.9 in an arm: components are floor- or ceiling-limited; shares are reported but flagged as uninformative

section12.label: descriptive (section 12 sensitivity analysis)
section12.variant_note: The deviation entry asks for a before/after comparison of the residual but does not fix how. The three variants here (pair level, within mixed cells, cell level) were chosen after RQ1 data collection began; none is primary.
section12.confound_note: The period is not randomised: simulations before the change are the earliest runs (the first task chunk and, for each simulator, the first trials), and the after period holds all later tasks and calendar days. Period is therefore confounded with task, simulator mix, trial index and time (e.g. drift in the hosted simulator). Differences are descriptive and cannot be attributed to --cache-ram.

h1c.label: exploratory (H1c)
h1c.period_note: Pair classes by the start times of the two repeats around the section 12 cutoff. A cross pair compares two llama-server setups (prompt-cache restores can change the agent's floating-point results), not two re-runs under one setup. Period is confounded with task chunk, trial order and calendar date, so the split is descriptive.

fidelity.label: exploratory (deterministic transcript checks, analyze --fidelity logic)
